# Neuvillette Character & Theorycrafting Guide (KQM)

## Overview & Playstyle
Neuvillette is a 5-star Hydro Catalyst user who functions as a premier on-field hypercarry. His damage relies entirely on his HP-scaling Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment, which fires a continuous torrent of water in a straight line, consuming his HP and absorbing Sourcewater Droplets to charge instantly.

### Core Mechanics & Sourcewater Droplets
- **Equitable Judgment**: If Neuvillette charges his attack, he consumes up to 3 Sourcewater Droplets in front of him to charge the beam instantly and heal himself. Without droplets, the charge takes several seconds.
- **Skill & Burst Generation**: His Elemental Skill (*O Tears, I Shall Recompense*) generates 3 droplets on hit. His Elemental Burst (*O Tides, I Have Returned*) generates 6 droplets.
- **A1 Passive (Past Draconic Glories)**: Triggers when a team member causes a Hydro-related reaction. Stackable up to 3 times (increases Equitable Judgment damage by 110%/125%/160%). Encourage running rainbow teams (different elements) at C0.

## Talent Priority
1. **Normal & Charged Attack: As Water Seeks Equilibrium** (Level 9 or 10 - Responsible for ~90% of total damage)
2. **Elemental Burst** (Level 8 or 9 - For droplet count and supplemental damage)
3. **Elemental Skill** (Level 8 - For droplet count)

## Stat Priorities & Substats
- **Sands**: HP% (or ER if below threshold)
- **Goblet**: Hydro DMG Bonus or HP% (very comparable, choose better substats)
- **Circlet**: CRIT DMG or CRIT Rate (careful not to overcap Crit Rate with Marechaussee Hunter set)
- **Energy Recharge**: Needs ~120% - 140% ER depending on Favonius teammates and double Hydro.

## Recommended Artifact Sets
1. **Marechaussee Hunter (4-Piece)**: BiS by a significant margin. Provides 15% Normal/Charged Attack DMG and 36% CRIT Rate when HP changes.
2. **Heart of Depth / Wanderer's Troupe (4-Piece)**: Decent placeholders.

## Weapon Rankings
1. **Tome of the Eternal Flow (5★)**: Signature and BiS. High CRIT DMG (88.2%), HP bonus, Charged Attack DMG bonus, and Energy recovery.
2. **Sacrificial Jade (4★ Battle Pass)**: Best alternative. Grants 36.8% CRIT Rate, and large HP and EM bonuses when off-field.
3. **Prototype Amber (4★ R5)**: Outstanding F2P option. Extends healing to the entire party, restores energy, and scales off HP.
